questions.question: Jesus told His twelve disciples what would happen to Him in Jerusalem. How did He say He would be treated?

answers.text: Mocked and insulted and spit upon
Welcomed and honored as a guest

questions.question: Jesus told His twelve disciples that He would rise again on the third day. True or false?
When a blind man near Jericho kept calling out to Jesus for mercy, what did Jesus do?

answers.text: Stopped and had him brought over
Told the crowd to quiet him
Called back to him and kept walking

questions.question: After Jesus healed a blind man near Jericho, what did the man do?

answers.text: Followed Jesus and gave God the glory
Went home and told his family
Ran into Jericho to tell the town
